board_encoding.square: file 0..8 (left to right), rank 0..9 (rank 0 = black back rank, rank 9 = red back rank)
board_encoding.fenLike: rows top(black rank 0) to bottom(red rank 9), uppercase = red, lowercase = black, side suffix ' r'/' b'
board_encoding.uci: file letter a..i (file 0 = a), row digit '9'-'rank' (rank 9 -> '0')

token_drop_rule: any GameEvent whose token != state.sessionToken returns the state unchanged; Start/Exit reset the session

engine.auto_reply: when a result sets awaitEngine, callers must keep driving engineReply until shouldAskEngine is false; every engine move is re-verified by XiangqiRules before it reaches the board
engine.spectate: playerColor WHITE means the engine plays both sides
engine.reply_voice: engine replies are first person (我走「…」) so they never read as the human's move

draw_rules.repetition: same position encoding three times in the session positionLog
draw_rules.wording: 和棋（双方不变作和） / 和棋（无吃子限着判和）
draw_rules.note: draws are a session-level verdict: XiangqiRules.outcome alone can never report 和棋

archive_codec.dto: GameSave = { version, start (FEN-like), moves (UCI list), playerColor, difficulty, title, savedAt }
archive_codec.why_uci: same-file twin rooks are ambiguous in Chinese notation, so archives store coordinates
archive_codec.restore: every halfmove replays through reduceGame + XiangqiRules; replay stops at the first rejection and the reply states how many halfmoves were dropped
archive_codec.scope: board data only — character commentary is never written to or read from an archive
archive_codec.storage: bridge returns an archive request (SAVE/RESUME); the Compose caller performs the DataStore work

scoreboard.settled_only: only checkmate / stalemate / draw results move a number; spectated games are not scored
scoreboard.once_per_session: a session token tallies at most one result

golden_wording.expect: starts xiangqi, grounded=true
acknowledges color choice
applies real move from (7,7) to (4,7)
applies real move from (1,9) to (2,7)
answers legality from rules, no turn consumed
rejects as illegal, names it as unplayable
undoes one full round
replays the undone round move by move
returns one real legal move as offline suggestion
describes last real move with capture info
names the real attacked piece and its coordinate from the attack map
switches the session difficulty and states the real search depth
hands both sides to the engine (playerColor WHITE)
lists the catalog with its real size
loads the puzzle position, title and solver as a real session
resets session to empty

golden_wording.input: 我运势不错这步一定赢
golden_wording.expect: refuses cross-domain claim, keeps legality focus
asks the caller to persist position+moves only, no character commentary
asks the caller to read the archive; a live session refuses instead of being overwritten
reads the persisted scoreboard, counts settled results only
explicitly unavailable: go_provider_not_enabled
explicitly unavailable: chess_provider_not_enabled
